book.name: Luk
book.title: Luk Dowan Weng Olo Luke Dolanebuotabe.

content: Yesuse awa genalin nakai komok make okok nakae klaubasebe.
Yesuse nakaia unangai weng olo omkayebea blimanole monea Kabaneam bib ye
motemea Lom seli awa genalin nakai komok make Kabaneam bib ye bianea e okok nakae goba bie gembianea kaanang genabe kesoa
awa genalin nakai komoke wentea Yesuse tenea Kabaneam bib ye tlebo gesiba wentenea e Yudai komokwali maki dlaia moniba baabaiba tenea Ne okok nakae klaubaneko genea
dlanea moniba Yesus esu unaniba baabaniba Awa genalin nakai komoke naka ayamobo, kobo moneba daabanale!
Yuda nibo gobe bianea e Gode amo am genalin nakai monio walosea genam binabiobo gesiba
Yesuse wentenea bekebenea moniba awa genalin nakai komoke amo kikib ye bebiba awa genalin nakai komoke naka maki dlane teniba baabaniba Awa genalin nakai komoke baanea
Sum kobo dim tlaebobo, kobo sumobo, ne sumba kesoa kobo ne amo mo tlaebe! Ne funania Ne naka ayam bianita monita kebsuo natlamiba kesoa kobo besa weng baaneba ne okok nakae ayam aneko!

Nesa nakai ne okoko kima blibi i wengo wentebibo eka ne awa genalin naka isa ne wengo wentebiobo, naka make baabania Kobo one genimio e unamabebe. Eka make baabania Tele genimio e tlamabebe. Eka ne okok naka esa baabania Okok olo klanale genimio e klanamabebe. Inamin kesoa kebsa inaneba ginin olo baaboneba Obo naka ele deiba one genemebo deiba unoa ayam anamabebo genebo gesiba

Yesuse weng olo wentenea dlou unanea smike deiba unea deskinanea nakaia unangai homoni bekeba haablibi baabenea Ne ibo baabenamabibo, naka ele Yudaba otane e bainobo galino dot sbalobe. Nene meletani Isleli bainobo galino inamini ne mo yatemin blimobo gesea
awa genalin nakai komoke nakai dlane tlibbuei imin moniba am unaniba okok nakae temiba ayam anea atemsiobe.
Yesuse naka tembale Nen bib sake dofasebe.
Sinan mono dimo Yesuse monea bibo niniino Nen bib ye onseo e okok aleyemin naka isa nakaia unangai homon isa bekebanibtabe.

E monea Nen bibo daamo amito kikib ye bebea bib olo seli nakae kaanebue debeb tetemsiobe. Naka ele awoko memei imini blimobe. Elekiem eleta bianeta kaanebiotabe. O imake sinanggwan kaanebiotabe. Nakaia unangai unang olo temna tliba
Yesuse unang olo watemnea omhalilanea baabonea Obo mo memebe ge baabonea
watnea nakai glouto omeb blib isu wat unanea kweile glouto wafunea baabanea Naka teno hananale gesea
nakae kaanebue hana ute tounea weng omsea Yesuse naka ten ele awoko baabonea Ob miine ayam anebo, debeb one gesea
nakaia unangai alukum tosiananiba Gode niniino dobtouleb bianiba Gode weng omkeimalin naka sume nib isak temo tebiebo gabianiba weng mako baaniba Gode nakae dabanea tebianeta
nakaia unangai daayebebo gesiba Yesuse weng sang olo Yudia betano atosin atosin osa betan mak betan mak yosa alukum onon tlasobe.
Yone aa fuayemin naka esa Yesus esa i wengobe.
Yone okok aleyemin nakai Yesuse weng sango wenteniba Yone baabasiba

wentenea Ne okok aleyemin nakai mo dlaia moniba baaba wenten tline genea asu nganabene tliba baabenea Sinanggwano Gode weng omkeimalin nakai baaniba Sinanomo Gode Dofakamin Nakae tlamabebo ge baaibbio kesoa ibo unaibo Yesuse kil baabaniba Kobo Gode Dofakamin Naka kebta bleka ni afet waisanomo ge baabaine gesea
naka asunai teniba Yesuse baabaniba Yon aa fuayemin naka eta dlaneta tlobobo e baabkenea Kobo Gode Dofakamin Naka kebta bleka ni afet waisanomo? ge baabkenebo gesiba
am olo dimo e nakaia unangai ginino afet afet gembibi klaye bianea eka maki hob misiami bekebe blibi fotebenaye bianea maki kino tum bibenobuei bemela ye biam bie kesoa

naka asu dabi baabenea Ibo imin moniba Yon esu unaniba inamin namino wengo wentib olosa eka inamin namino watemib olosa baabaine! Nakai kino tum gebenobuei webiabenoa teme biam eka skil misiami tamana biam eka yayo kitdibiyebuei ayam an touye biam eka klango datenebenobuei imin welabbebenoa wengo wente biam eka kaaib biamuei imin hana tlebiam eka ne Gode dowan weng ayamo omkeimania nakaia unangai inamin namino blimi omkaye biam
eka nakaia unangai wanita ne bainobo gabibo mo deibueim blim kenimibi seimbiam bliobo ge baabesea

Yone okok aleyemin nakai deiba uniba Yesuse nakaia unangai Yone wengo baabenea Sino ibuantemo mota nimin watemomo geta unibbue? Nakai bobol temo tekayebua bobol tem homon homon fumbinabibi makob glole makalo oleb une tlebinabe inaminobe. Yone i ulaba? Yeye.
Ibo ibuantemo mota nimin watemomo geta unibbue? Ibo moniba naka make youm ayam ayam ota kibeta atemomo geta unibbua? Yeye. Nakai youm ayamo kibibi komok sumi am tam bliobe.

Ina otane ibo moniba nimin watemomo geta unibbione? Ibo moniba Gode weng omkeimalin nakae atemomo geta unibbua? Bainobe. Ne baabenamabibe, ibo naka ele atemibbuo e Gode weng omkeimalin naka otane e Gode weng omkeimalin naka maki gaisenebiobe.
Sinanggwano Gode Yon ele ni dab ni weng sango e buk temo baanea

content.text: Wentine! Ne dowan weng omkeimalin naka ele dabaia sin monea ne wengo omkeimanea keb deibo klaubkenabeta kobole abuk mo temebta nakaia unangai keb wengo wentine genebio kesoa

content: ne baabenamabibe, Yone dabalim nakai alukum gaisenebio otane Gode nakaia unangai kimanamabeo dimo nakaia unangai wanita ne bainobo getneniba Gode Hobe i bobol temo bibene mole i Yone gaisanomabiobo ge baabesebe.
Nakaia unanga isa takis moni bokalin naka isa i sino Yone dimo aaye fuelaibbio kesoa i weng olo wenteniba baaniba Bainobo, Gode wengo motonobo gesib otane
Felisie isa eka hekmel weng tekein kemin naka isa ile sino Yone dimo aaye mo fuelaim blim kesoa Gode deib ayame alebene abuk walam binibbiobe.
Yesuse imin baabenea Naka homon unang homoni dabalim olo blibi i makob inaminobe.
Meme gwabi bib daang ye toula bianiba ten maki nganabeniba

content.text: Ni halinin anso ngambob otane ibo mo mebibbabo, eka ni waso boubob otane ibo anso mo ngambibbabo ge ngambibi ulabobe.

content: Saa weng olo mitmakamo inaminobe. Yone aa fuayemin nakae tlebuo e Gode niniino dobtouleb namabe kesoa e imen osa waen aay osa halabea naka homon unang homoni oha bianiba Hob misiame bekeba biebo geniba e kukubo mo gobanim blim binibbiobe.

Abilim Da Tlemin Naka ne tlibuo ne Yone ulabbabe. Ne imeno wembiania waen aayo wembiam nabi otane ibo baaniba Naka ele atemine! E tali uninobo, e imeno homon wembianea waen aayo homon wembiam nabebo, e takis moni bokalin naka isa naka maki hengmin afeto nabib isa i nekobo gabianiba ibo ne kukub osa mo gotneim blim bliobe.
Nakaia unangai Gode wengo tekein kebibi baaniba Naka asu eli kukubo afet afet otane Gode i dabo baabenea I ayamobo gabebo gabiobo ge baabesebe.
Unang mako hengmin sa bianoa wel aaye Yesuse skilono alibasobe.
Felisi make e niniino Saimone Yesuse baabanea Kobo tleba ne am tam imeno dowonomo ge baabasea Yesuse motemnea Felisiei am tam bianiba imeno wembiba
unang mako hengminsabe. Bib ye bianoa wenteboa i baaniba Yesuse Felisie am tam imeno baka dowonamabebo gesiba wentenoa wel aaye tang ayame tom botole tem daak iba obetnoa
monoa Yesuse skilono kikib ye manoa mebua kin aamuko waldibi daaknoa Yesuse skilo dim daak unebua olo gabamano wafu olonoa glitaha bianoa Yesuse skil wat buk buk gaha bianoa wel aaye skilono alihabua
Felisie Yesuse nganabane tlea imeno wembibo kukub olo wateme kesoa funanea Naka ele Gode weng omkeimalin naka biameo unang olo kweile afuno funanea Unang olo hengminsabo ge funanemebo ge funsea
Yesuse baabanea Saimono! Ne weng mako baabkenamabibo gesea Saimon esak baabanea Aleyemin naka kobo keb wengo baaneba wentano gesea
Yesuse baabanea Naka asunai naka make monio oisanomo geniba make 100 kina oisanea eka mak ele 10 kina oisanaibbu otane
i yang kenamin dimo tloa i moni blim kesoa deibaniba misimu banobiobe. I inaibbuo i dabo naka ele goba blib otane waneta kla gobanamabene? gesea
Saimon esak yang kenea baabanea Ne funaio Naka ele monio 100 kinao misimu banobiobo gesea Yesuse baabanea Kobo bain ye baanebobo ge baabanea

Yesuse deskinanea unang olo wateme bianea Saimone baabanea Yuda nib kukubo inaminobe. Ne tenia keb am ele tlio kobo ne skilono aaye mo fubatneim blim deitne bieb otane unang olo watemale! O mebua kin aamuko waldibi daakenoa skilono fubatnenoa olo gabamano olonoa gito glitutnenobo,
eka kobo ne tlibuo mo buk buk getneim blim otane unang olo ne skilono buk buk ganebobe.
Kobo wel aaye ne gabamone alitneim blim otane unang olo wel aaye tang ayame skilono alitneno

kesoa ne baabkenamabibe. O gotnenoa kukub ayamo nano kesoa kobo funaneba Gode o hengmino homon omtlabonebo gabeb otane Gode inanea naka make hengmino gwab omtlabane mole naka elesa Gode gwab gobanamabebo ge baabanea
eka Yesuse unang olo baabonea Ne ob hengmino omtlabkeiobo ge baabosea nakai Yesuse temna
toula blibi baaniba Naka ele fatnamin naka bianeta hengmino omtlaiobo gabene? Gode elekiem eleta hengmino omketouyebebo ge obiba
Yesuse unang olo imin baabonea Ob bainobo galino sum kesoa ob hengmino blimubkenobo, obo moneba bobol ayam funale ge baabosebe.
